title: Grand Kiosk, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Grand/Mecidiye Kiosk: long low pale plaster hall, round-headed brown-framed windows, two real garden entrances and steps, end-wall recessed urn niche, tall flat pilasters, simplified pale carved scroll/rosette reliefs, deep dentil cornice, lead roof behind a low parapet and six capped chimneys. Preserve the independently mapped Wardrobe Chamber and neighbouring terrace/mosque. No copied inscriptions/art, furnished interior or invented dome.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Independent Grand Kiosk Q20471823 confirmed by Wikidata and its Commons category; exact named OSM way32396254 v21/native35184404485086 and twelve-corner parent.
